description: Use while setting a saved plan up, after the user finishes part of a step ("the Supabase client is installed", "sign-in works on the live site"). Changes data; needs sign-in. Each build-pack step (domain, hosting, database, auth, …: the checklist ids from get_build_pack) has one state: not_started, dependency_installed, configuration_present, connection_tested, feature_verified, deployment_verified, or unknown. connection_tested and above need evidence: what the user ran and saw (a status code, a record id, "signed in on the deployed URL"). Never record a state the user hasn't confirmed, and never put a key, password or connection string in evidence: anything that looks like one is removed before it is stored. These are the user's reports (basis user_reported); only check_build verifies anything, and only that a package is in the code. Setup never changes which services the plan uses: a different vendor is a change to price with price_change. Returns the checklist and the next step, so setup can resume later without repeating finished steps.

evidence.description: What shows it, in the user's words. Required for connection_tested, feature_verified and deployment_verified. No secret values.

step.description: The checklist step id: domain or the step's category (hosting, database, auth…).

vendor_id.description: The service the user set up, if they named one: it must be the plan's.

name: record_setup_progress

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

completeness.description: On plan and project results: complete, complete_with_assumptions, incomplete or needs_clarification, with the reasons. Say plainly when it is not complete.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

project.description: On results about a saved project: its id and the context version the answer was computed on. Pass both back in follow-up calls.

title: Record a setup step's state, with evidence
